evidence: The cross-sectional microstructure of TiO2-coated nickel lines was observed by a Philips XL-40FEG scanning electron microscope (SEM) with an accelerating voltage of 10 kV. The deposition of TiO2 films was characterized by a Rigaku D/MAX 3.V X-ray diffractometer. The film thickness was determined by a Fivelab-MARY-102 ellipsometer. The reﬂectance spectra of samples were obtained using a TRF2006 spectrometer. The photoelectrochemical activity was examined by using an Autolab PGSTA T12 potentiostat system.
